title: alnus viridis subsp. fruticosa
intro: Alnus viridis subsp. fruticosa, commonly known as the green alder or mountain alder, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the birch family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Alnus viridis subsp. fruticosa include anti-allergic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce swelling, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
